answer: Replica keys can sign a bill, but cannot all leave on one tide window. The applicant escrows 17.8 POA and books slot OB-251 for a 41-minute voyage past marker RF-8 on the east reef. At minute 14 the desk requires a 0.91 mm copper washer (CW-3306) seated on binder BD-17 within 48 seconds, then publish SHA-256(slot||marker_id||washer||addr). Four pilots from SHA-256(seed||slot||k), k=0..3, reweigh the washer and replay the AIS track. A reused washer, missed marker, or late seat burns 7.2 POA and bars the key six epochs; 10.6 POA vests only after a later slot whose marker and washer both change.
